content.description: Internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire (CIQ): cases from creation to the final PDF with a parallel department review, open points, change requests, suppliers, versioned configuration, released sections, scope runs, RMES sheets, internal notes and a tamper-evident audit trail. Suppliers work only in the separate portal.

source.precedence: PART A > PART B (v4) > PART C > PART D (field-level only, where it agrees with v4)
source.open_questions: runs/ciq-digital-v4/open-questions.md Q1-Q7: defaults accepted; none adds a flow, role or step

mechanism_selection.note: No Case/Board or Dataset flows. All three Processes need role-assigned steps, step conditions, parallel blocks and per-step field permissions; the process mechanism supports all of them, and the case mechanism supports none (capabilities workflow.mechanisms.case: false). Every other entity only stores data: a Data Form (A1 L22-L23).

roles.name: CIQ RMM
roles.rationale: Creates the case and holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step, Scope check, both open-items checks and the RMM branch of Part 2 (brd.md L157, L184-L193). Holds 'Waiting for supplier' and 'Review – RMM' on CIQ Open Point and Triage on CIQ Change Request (L245-L246, L270). Writes CIQ Supplier, CIQ Section and CIQ Scope Run (L278-L281).

roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – Safety' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – Safety' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237). Sole editor of CIQ RMES Safety and records its own internal RMES decision (A3 L64; L282-L283).

roles.name: CIQ QM Reviewer

roles.name: CIQ Microbiology Reviewer
roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – Microbiology' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – Microbiology' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237).

roles.name: CIQ Sustainability Reviewer
roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – Sustainability' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – Sustainability' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237).

roles.name: CIQ Overall Approver
roles.rationale: Owns 'Overall approval' on CIQ Case, which runs only when switched on (brd.md L145, L159, L191; A3 L63).

roles.name: CIQ Business Admin
roles.rationale: Writes CIQ Config Version, including Release rows, with no four-eyes (brd.md L146, L279; A3 L65).

roles.name: CIQ Reader
roles.rationale: One read-only role for Customs, Legal, Auditor and Process Owner (brd.md L147; PART D L1241). It may post internal notes (open question Q7 default).

roles.name: CIQ Case Admin
roles.rationale: Ends a case during Part 2 through the admin route and ends the case's open points and change requests (brd.md L148, L215, L217). Flow Admin is set over REST after generate (A2 L56; L416). Its members also hold CIQ RMM (PART D L1242).

roles.name: CIQ Integration Service
roles.rationale: The CIQ Sync Service and the integrations: creates CIQ Change Request at Start (Y6), writes CIQ Section and CIQ Audit Event (brd.md L149, L269, L280, L285; A3 L61). Never acts on a human step after Start (A2 L58).

flows.name: CIQ Case
flows.description: One CIQ case cycle, from creation to the final PDF: supplier hand-offs, scope check, the parallel department review, optional overall approval and the single final release. Holds the material identity, the case contacts as fields, the six department lanes, the PS-05/PS-11 confirmations, the RMES header and the gate/hold counts.
flows.rationale: Moves between RMM, five departments in parallel and the Overall Approver through steps that carry SLAs: a Process (A1 L22; brd.md L119, L154-L194). Typed now because a Form can't gain a workflow later (LESSONS 1).
flows.build_stage: generate (complete; a published Process can't be edited, LESSONS 1b)

flows.name: CIQ Open Point
flows.description: One question, document request or additional part to the supplier, with every back-and-forth round inside the same item. Also the internal kinds Department review, Contact update and Internal review, which skip the supplier step.

child_tables.name: Rounds
child_tables.writer: Only the owning department writes it, at its own review step (L251).
child_tables.evidence: brd.md L120; L251; L327; A2 L31 (example Rounds_Round_No)

flows.rationale: Raised by a department, waits for the supplier, then reviewed by exactly one owning department, with SLAs on each step: a Process (brd.md L120, L222-L247). Its own item, not a case child table: six departments raise points at the same time in Part 2 (L328, C2/C3).
flows.build_stage: generate (complete; a published Process can't be edited, LESSONS 1b)

flows.name: CIQ Change Request
flows.description: A change the supplier reports or requests (change notice, correction, attempt after the final release). RMM triages it, the affected departments assess it in parallel, and the supplier gets the outcome as a portal notice.
flows.rationale: Triage by RMM, then a parallel assessment by the impacted departments, each with an SLA: a Process (brd.md L121, L253-L272).
flows.build_stage: generate (complete; a published Process can't be edited, LESSONS 1b)

flows.name: CIQ Supplier
flows.description: One supplier company with its people. Supplier_Code is the isolation key on every portal item.

child_tables.name: Contacts
child_tables.writer: CIQ RMM writes rows one at a time, re-reads and merges (L278).

flows.rationale: Master data with no routing: a Data Form (A1 L23; brd.md L122, L278). Contacts are a child table: one writer, small, parent mirrors cover search (L329).

flows.name: CIQ Config Version
flows.description: Every configuration version and kind (template, section definition, rule set, ownership, RMES criteria, limits, texts, reminders, settings), plus Release rows holding the full frozen bundle a case pins. Copy-on-write.
flows.rationale: Stored data with no steps (no four-eyes, A3 L65): a Data Form (brd.md L123, L279). CIQ Config Release is folded into Release rows (L136).

flows.name: CIQ Section
flows.description: One released section of a case: what was released, why, and for which department. The app twin of the portal section. The K2.1 row carries the component list; K2.1 and BASIC rows carry the search mirrors.

child_tables.name: Components
child_tables.writer: K2.1 row only. CIQ RMM or the sync-service rebuild writes it (L280, L332).

flows.rationale: Written once per release and later by the component rebuild, with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L124, L280). Own rows, not a case child table: each row fires X2 and rows are added when RMM holds no case step (L333, C1/C3).

flows.name: CIQ Scope Run
flows.description: One run of the scope rules (initial, extension, change notice, additional part, reactivation), with every section's classification including N.A. and the rule and answer behind it. Additions only.
flows.rationale: Stored data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L125, L281). Own rows: runs come from different people at different times (L334, C3).

flows.name: CIQ RMES Safety
flows.description: Safety's RMES sheet for one case: all criteria and findings in one row, with header counts that feed the case gate and an edit lock.

child_tables.name: Criteria
child_tables.writer: Safety only, one user at a time (Editing_By / Editing_Since lock, L282).

flows.rationale: Working data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L126, L282). A separate Form from Regulatory so Safety and Regulatory can't edit each other (REQ-CFG-004, L331, C4).

flows.name: CIQ RMES Regulatory
flows.description: Regulatory's RMES sheet for one case; same shape as CIQ RMES Safety.
flows.rationale: As CIQ RMES Safety, for Regulatory (brd.md L127, L283, L331).

flows.name: CIQ Internal Note
flows.description: Internal chat, one message per row. Never visible to suppliers.
flows.rationale: Stored data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L128, L284). One row per message because many people post at any time (L337, C2).

flows.name: CIQ Audit Event
flows.description: Who did what and when, on which value and which document. Also notifications, delegations, assignments, section-review marks, scope, configuration, change attempts, cancellations, snapshots and item-created events.
flows.rationale: Stored data with no steps: a Data Form (brd.md L129, L285). Tamper-evident claim (A3 L66). Target of Z1/Z3/Z4 and source of Z2 (open questions Q1, Q5).

id_reservations.note: Flow ids are the name-derived ids we expect (name with underscores + _A00); the platform assigns the real ids, read back after generate. List ids carry NO _A00 suffix so display names stay clean (A2 L35). Role ids are stable IR slugs; live role _ids are read back. Step ids are prefixed per flow (CASE_, OPNT_, CHRQ_) so they can't collide with field ids such as OP_Key or CR_Key.

CIQ_Case_A00.lane_prefix: <D>_ for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS, RMM
CIQ_Case_A00.rule: v4 names first (L197-L206, L189, L191), then PART D L733-L782 where it agrees with v4. Material fields are plain Text on the case (no CIQ Raw Material, L132). Contacts are fields, never a child table (L330). Gate and hold counts are plain Number fields written by the acting person's Workbench (A2 L32-L33, e.g. Open_Items_Count, Open_CR_Count, <D>_Open_Count, <D>_RMES_Gaps) read by blank-safe formulas; no aggregates. The step-condition fields above are reserved.

CIQ_Open_Point_A00.rule: v4 L244-L251, then PART D L887-L912 where it agrees (one item per point, not per round). Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Rounds columns use the Rounds_ prefix (A2 L31).

CIQ_Change_Request_A00.prefix: CR_ for identity and outcome; Impact_<D> and <D>_ assessment fields for D in REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS
CIQ_Change_Request_A00.rule: v4 L267-L272, then PART D L957-L966. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Y6 fills the case keys it has (Case_Code, Cycle_No); RMM sets Case_Item_Id at Triage.

CIQ_Supplier_A00.rule: v4 L278, then PART D L1109. Contacts columns use the Contacts_ prefix (A2 L31). Never 'Country': use Supplier_Country_Code.

CIQ_Config_Version_A00.prefix: Config_ for version fields; Release_ for Release-row fields
CIQ_Config_Version_A00.rule: v4 L279, then PART D L1140 and the Release fields of PART D P5 (L1043-L1048), which v4 folds into Release rows.

CIQ_Section_A00.rule: v4 L280 and the X2 set 1:1 with the portal CIQP Section (PART C), then PART D L991-L1012. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Components columns use the Components_ prefix (A2 L31).

CIQ_Scope_Run_A00.rule: v4 L281, then PART D L1067. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent).

CIQ_RMES_Safety_A00.rule: v4 L282: one row per case keyed by the case's RMES_Key, a Reference to the case (Result_Case, PART D L1166), header counts (open criteria, open blocking findings), the lock. Case-scoped records carry the case's text keys Case_Item_Id (the case item _id), Case_Code and Cycle_No (PART D L722-L724, used where v4 is silent). Criteria columns use Criteria_, Findings columns use Findings_ (A2 L31).

CIQ_RMES_Regulatory_A00.rule: Same schema as CIQ RMES Safety (v4 L283).

CIQ_Internal_Note_A00.rule: v4 L284, then PART D L1199 (Note_Key, Case_Code, Cycle_No, Linked_Kind, Linked_Key, Note_Text, Note_Author, Note_Dept, Note_At).

CIQ_Audit_Event_A00.rule: v4 L285, then PART D L1092-L1097. Notification and delegation fields included (categories L285).

global_field_rules: Never author Name; never name a field Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project; owner-prefix generic words (A2 L41-L42).
No aggregates of any kind (A2 L32). Gates and holds: plain Number count fields plus blank-safe formulas; a blank count holds and never deadlocks (A2 L33-L34).
A child column never reuses a header field id: prefix it with its table's column_id_prefix, same label (A2 L31).
A field an integration copies has the same type as its portal counterpart (Text, Number, Date, DateTime, Email), never a Select (PART D L733).
Fields beyond v4 only where PART D gives field-level detail that agrees with v4, or where PART A requires them (Number count fields for gates).

hard_rules.rule: Exactly 11 flows (Processes CIQ Case, CIQ Open Point, CIQ Change Request; Forms CIQ Supplier, CIQ Config Version, CIQ Section, CIQ Scope Run, CIQ RMES Safety, CIQ RMES Regulatory, CIQ Internal Note, CIQ Audit Event), 7 embedded child tables, 2 native References (ER01, ER02), 22 lists, 11 custom roles plus Admin and User reused. No portal (CIQP) flow, no 'CIQ ZZ Spike' flow, no CIQ Raw Material / Case Contact / Supplier Contact / Component / Config Release / per-round / Item Register flow. Every flow and list name starts with 'CIQ '.

Step ids, names, kinds, owners and conditions exactly as id_reservations.step_prefix_by_flow, byte-exact with the en-dash U+2013. First and last steps unconditioned. 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review' is one Parallel step with six single-step branches; 'Assess impact' is one Parallel step with five. The six Open Point review steps are sequential conditional steps (exactly one runs), not a parallel block. No explicit Reject/Cancel steps (native reject and send-back, LESSONS 13). Every human step carries an SLA; durations are set by BDF after generate. No step is assigned to CIQ Integration Service after Start.

Field names per id_reservations.field_prefix_by_flow and global_field_rules. Native References only ER01 and ER02 (Result_Case on both RMES Forms); every other link is a Text key (text_key_links) and must NOT become a Reference. Child tables use the reserved child_table_ids and display names; columns use the column_id_prefix. Author the 22 lists with the reserved list ids (no _A00) and items. The reserved step-condition fields (Dept_<D>_Active, OP_To_Supplier, OP_Dept, Impact_<D>, Overall_Approval_Required, Overall_Decision, Hold_For_Open_Items) must exist with values that match the conditions.

Initiators: CIQ Case = CIQ RMM; CIQ Open Point = CIQ RMM and the five Reviewer roles; CIQ Change Request = CIQ Integration Service and CIQ RMM. Name the trade-off that Editable on a Process grants InitiateItems (A2 L56; LESSONS 18). CIQ RMES Safety editable by CIQ Safety Reviewer only, CIQ RMES Regulatory by CIQ Regulatory Reviewer only. Child-table step permissions by table key only. Flow Admin for CIQ Case Admin and no-Delete members are post-generate items. Every role in journey_flow_map must be able to read each flow on its path.

risks.risk: A parallel block whose branches are all skipped: 'Assess impact' on every refused change request (all Impact flags 'No', L270), and Part 2 if no department is active. Runtime fork/join is still being tested (A2 L28, K-PAR). If an all-skipped join doesn't advance, the item hangs.

Return on CIQ Open Point is a native send-back from a review step to 'Waiting for supplier'; whether a send-back re-fires X3 is K-09h (fallback X3b on ItemSentBack). Send-back must be on only at the review steps (L414).
